about: part06 B1-B8: wrong NPCs, spawn spots and directions

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET TargetName = replace(TargetName, 'Breeda;200|', 'Torrance;200|') WHERE ID = 20836
entries.why: step 1 sent Naturalists to Breeda (Naturalist trainer, Mag Mell) although the text and period walkthrough say the Druid trainer at the tower over the bridge from Connla: Torrance (Druid Trainer, Shannon Estuary 22931,30813; CapnBry 23028,30945)
step 1 marker moved from Breeda to Torrance
